name: Shuanglong Chen
title: Full-stack Developer | Vibe Coder
bio: A full-stack developer passionate about redefining development with AI. With 3+ years of experience, built solid frontend engineering skills at Meituan and DeepWisdom. Now fully embracing AI programming - proficient with Claude Code for Vibe Coding, complemented by Codex and Gemini. Also experienced with AI IDEs like Cursor, Trae, and Antigravity. Independently developed 10+ projects. I believe AI-assisted programming is the future, and I enjoy the entire journey from idea to product.
philosophy: Great code should be like a work of art - functional yet beautiful and maintainable. The value of technology lies in solving real problems, and user experience always comes first.
